milestone.title: Plan persistence reliability: silent failures, gate drift, write-path consistency

intent.outcome: Plan reads fail loudly on corruption; gate checks use a single source of truth for thresholds; every milestone mutation path syncs the index and validates schema; completion guardrail has bounded runtime; concurrency hazard is either enforced in code or covered by a real regression test.

problem.description: Code review found several reliability gaps in the persistence and validation layer that can produce false-green states or silent data loss. (1) store::load_config silently returns ProjectConfig::default() on parse/read failure — gates and strictness can change without error. (2) validate_milestone_review() hardcodes G4 out-of-scope minimum at 2 while validate_plan() respects config.min_out_of_scope() — approve can pass while mp validate fails. (3) step/wp/delta writers call store::write_milestone directly without sync_plan, causing plan.toml index drift (W03) until manual mp sync. (4) enforce_milestone_file schema validation runs on milestone create/update but NOT on step/wp mutations — invalid shapes can be persisted via the most common write paths. (5) validate_plan uses unwrap_or_default() on load_all_milestones and swallows annotation load errors — disk failures look like empty plan. (6) ac_verify subprocess runs with no timeout — hung step tests block completion indefinitely. (7) concurrency.rs is a compile-only stub despite documented parallel step-add clobber risk (AGENTS.md warns agents not to parallelize plan writes).

in_scope: load_config: return/ propagate parse errors or at minimum log+surface a doctor/validate warning when config.toml is unreadable or invalid
Unify G4 (and any similar) between validate_plan and validate_milestone_review/ready — pass PlanContext config into review gates
Centralize milestone write path: step.rs, wp.rs, delta.rs, plan_gaps.rs route through with_milestone_mut or a write_milestone_and_sync helper that always calls sync_plan
Call enforce_milestone_file on all milestone file writes (step/wp/status mutations)
validate_plan: propagate load_all_milestones and load_annotations errors instead of unwrap_or_default / empty vec
ac_verify: add configurable timeout (env or constant) for subprocess execution; fail with clear message on timeout

Replace concurrency.rs stub with a test demonstrating parallel step add clobber OR document + enforce single-writer in store (minimal: test that sequential writes preserve all steps; stretch: file lock or --if-updated on step add)
out_of_scope: Full multi-file transactional archive (archive_milestone rename + index append) — separate follow-up if needed
Optimistic concurrency on every write (M09 shipped --if-updated on milestone update; extend only if test proves need)

acceptance_criteria.description: Corrupt config.toml surfaces as error or validate/doctor warning — not silent default config
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo test -p mp --test config_load_reliability: W50 validate + doctor config_parse + write-block + E02/E03

acceptance_criteria.description: G4 threshold in approve/review path matches config.min_out_of_scope() — no hardcoded 2
step add/update triggers plan index sync — no W03 drift after step mutation without manual mp sync
Invalid milestone shape written via step add is rejected by schema enforcement
ac_verify times out hung subprocess within bounded wall clock
concurrency.rs tests real write behavior (not empty stub)

open_questions.question: Should corrupt config.toml block all writes (strict) or warn-and-continue with defaults (lenient)?
open_questions.answer: Strict on write paths (bail with context); doctor/validate warn on read — fail loud, no silent defaults

steps.action: Fix load_config: propagate or surface corrupt config.toml — no silent ProjectConfig::default() on parse failure
steps.done_when: Corrupt config surfaces error or doctor/validate warning

steps.action: Unify G4 threshold: validate_milestone_review/ready use cfg.min_out_of_scope() not hardcoded 2
steps.done_when: Approve and validate agree on G4

steps.action: Introduce write_milestone_synced helper; route step.rs, wp.rs, delta.rs, plan_gaps.rs through it (always sync_plan)
steps.done_when: Step mutation does not cause W03 drift

steps.action: Call enforce_milestone_file on all milestone file writes including step/wp mutations
steps.done_when: Invalid shape via step add is rejected

steps.action: validate_plan: propagate load_all_milestones and load_annotations errors instead of unwrap_or_default
steps.done_when: Disk failures do not produce false-green validate

steps.action: ac_verify: add subprocess timeout with clear failure message
steps.done_when: Hung test fails within bounded wall clock

steps.action: Replace concurrency.rs stub with real test (sequential step chain preserved; document parallel clobber if lock not implemented)

verification.evidence: cargo test -p mp --test config_load_reliability --test gate_matrix --test index_auto_sync --test schema_on_step_write --test ac_verify_timeout --test concurrency: all pass; cargo test -p mp: all pass
